verdict.rationale: ClickUp's own marketing explicitly claims 'Build your own agent' and highlights prebuilt agents (Codegen, Triage) alongside a 'Super Agent' with delegation and memory, indicating a custom-agent-building feature exists. However, the evidence is all first-party marketing copy with no documentation of the actual configuration UI/workflow, no independent hands-on verification, and no detail on customization depth or limits. Missing for 10: detailed docs on agent configuration steps/parameters, independent or community confirmation of building a custom agent, and clarity on how flexible/extensible the agent builder is.
